name: lqhd-customers-finder
description: A 6-role expert team that sources overseas buyers, investigates backgrounds, processes Teyi company lists and contact lists (with MCP workbench data exchange), generates role-tailored outreach emails and delivers client development reports.

displayDescription.en: A 6-role foreign trade team covering user company profiling, client sourcing and matching, background checks, Teyi company and contact list processing with MCP workbench exchange, email generation and outreach, and client / regional sourcing reports. The lead dispatches the right specialist and delivers ready-to-use results.
